editorial.summary: The episode reviews the technical breakdown of Block Blast's server-driven ad monetization logic, analyzes top 50 mobile puzzle game retention and monetization benchmarks from AppMagic, covers Fortnite's legal return to the Australian App Store, summarizes soft launch updates from Supercell and Playrix, reports Hasbro's Q3 Monopoly Go licensing revenue, and highlights key findings from the 2026 Top 50 Mobile Game Makers list.
